current_evidence: The 2026 PDF could not be fetched (council site returns robots_disallowed), the council's planning and guidance pages carry no linked list or date, and the national planning.data.gov.uk record (entry date 2026-10-16) still points to Validation_Document_October_2023.pdf. So whether the 2026 list (footer text 'Local Validation List - Adopted 2026' in Grokbot's own extract) is the formally current one could not be confirmed.

issues.detail: Grokbot mixed two different lists. Many requirements and triggers come from the superseded Validation_Document_October_2023.pdf (Archaeology, BNG, Design and Access Statement, Planning/Energy Statement, Landscape/LVIA, Odour/Vibration, Open Space, Planning Statement, Retail Impact, Structural Survey, Travel Plan, Marketing Evidence, SAMMM), while others come from the 2026 list. If the 2026 list is the adopted one, triggers taken from the 2023 document may be out of date.
issues.evidence: app_type_rows 'source' fields alternate between Validation_Document_October_2023.pdf and ESBC Local Validation List 2026.pdf

issues.detail: The List date 2026-09-01 comes from PDF metadata (CreationDate), not from the document text. Grokbot's own extract of the document text only shows 'Adopted 2026', with no day or month. The date could not be checked against the source.
issues.evidence: reference_row 'Date basis': 'PDF metadata CreationDate'; extracted footer 'East Staffordshire Borough Council - Local Validation List - Adopted 2026'

issues.detail: Several requirements are matched to text about a different requirement. 'Sequential / Exception Test (flood)' is given the Retail Sequential Test trigger ('main town centre uses outside of town centres'). 'Schedule of works (listed building)' and 'Ecological Survey' are both given tree method statement text. 'Energy / Sustainability Statement' is given the generic 'Planning and Sustainability Statement' trigger. 'Planning Statement' is given the older-persons specialised housing trigger, which belongs to a housing need statement.
issues.evidence: Sequential/Exception Test trigger: 'Retail Sequential Test This is required when applications are proposing main tele uses outside of town centres'; Schedule of works trigger: 'The Method Statement should provide details of the protection of trees'

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts are fragments or are cut off, so they do not say when the requirement applies. Examples: Arboricultural ('and written arboricultural advice relating to the health or safety of the tree(s).'), Archaeology ('an appropriate desk-based assessment and, where necessary, a field evaluation.'), BNG ('of how biodiversity net gain has been achieved'), Design and Access Statement (ends 'with the following types of application only: 1.'), Flood Risk ('and submit a Flood Risk Assessment where required.'), Transport ('that no Transport Assessment or Statement is required.'), SCI ('a separate statement of community involvement may be appropriate.'), Odour/Vibration ('Proposals which raise issues of disturbance a. b. c. d. e. f.'), Retail Impact (cut off at 'Uttoxeter - 750 sq').

Page header and footer text from the PDF is mixed into triggers (Noise Impact Assessment, Ventilation/Extraction, Photographs, tree photographs tab item). The 2026 typo 'main tele uses' (should be 'main town centre uses') is copied without comment.
issues.evidence: '...annotated to show the proposed East Staffordshire Borough Council - Local Validation List - Adopted 2026 Page 6 ... When Required / Notes Mandatory? works.'

issues.detail: About 30 requirements are put under 'Full planning' with the note 'INFERRED: application type not named', even though the list mostly sets triggers by development type or location (for example Air Quality near AQMAs, Heritage near conservation areas or heritage assets, Lighting for external lighting, Roof plan where the roof is affected). These apply equally to householder, outline and other types. As a result, Householder shows only the Design and Access Statement, and Outline shows only Structural Survey.
issues.evidence: Householder rows: only 'Design and Access Statement'; Outline rows: only 'Structural Survey'

issues.detail: Several rows are filed under the wrong application type. 'Change of use - prior approval' gets Energy/Sustainability ('major change of use applications', which is a full planning change of use, not prior approval), Marketing evidence (loss of retail/community facilities is a planning application test) and 'Agricultural / rural workers' dwelling appraisal', whose trigger actually EXCLUDES agricultural workers' dwellings and Class Q. 'Listed building consent' gets 'Advertisement drawings / illumination details'. 'Outline' gets Structural Survey only because the text says 'outline any repairs'.
issues.evidence: Agricultural row trigger: '...excluding agricultural workers dwellings, replacement dwellings or rural conversions or Class Q developments.'; Outline trigger: '...and outline any repairs, or demolition works necessary'

issues.detail: The council's 'what you need to submit' page lists 'Housing Needs Survey' and 'Cannock Chase Special Area of Conservation Developer Contributions' as conditional requirements. Neither appears as a requirement in app_type_rows; the only trace of the Cannock Chase SAC item is the fragment 'These are referred to as Strategic Access Management and Monitoring Measures (SAMMM).' The SAC trigger (for example new dwellings within the SAC zone of influence) was not captured.
issues.evidence: Council page: 'Depending on the details of your application, you'll sometimes need: ... Housing Needs Survey ... Cannock Chase Special Area of Conservation Developer Contributions ...'

issues.detail: Tab items include contact details and process text rather than requirements: 'Further Advice Details of Air Quality Management Areas ... can be emailed to you on request: pollution.team@...', 'Pre-application advice is available for householder, minor, and major applications.' The 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' app-type row is a table-of-contents fragment ('Contact & Pre-Application Advice .......31'). 'These are referred to as SAMMM' is a sentence fragment.
issues.evidence: tab_items 'Submission rules' and 'Policy-driven requirements'; app_type_rows 'Pre-application advice / engagement details'

issues.detail: The 'Drawing / document standards' tab repeats near-identical scale lines ('Draw/Drawn to an appropriate metric scale for example, 1:50 or 1:100' four times, '1:100, 1:200 or 1:500' twice). The tree photograph sentence appears twice (once with header text included). Noise Impact Assessment and Ventilation/Extraction share the same garbled excerpt. 'Advertisement drawings' is repeated under both LBC and Advertisement consent.
issues.evidence: tab_items lines 'Draw to an appropriate metric scale for example, 1:50 or 1:100; 2.' / 'Drawn to an appropriate metric scale for example, 1:50 or 1:100.' etc.

summary: The 2026 list Grokbot links could not be fetched because the council site blocks automated access, so contents were not checked against the source. Grokbot's data still shows serious problems: it mixes in the superseded October 2023 document, mismatches several triggers (flood sequential test matched to retail, schedule of works matched to tree text), gives truncated excerpts, files most items under 'Full planning' by guesswork, and dates the list from PDF metadata.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
